lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Are you sure this was supposed to go to me and not Miku?
: Why would I ever send this to Miku?
: Why would you ever send ME a picture like this when you despise the only one I already have?
: PROBABLY because you took that without my consent and STILL talk about it years later
: How could I not? You look so beautiful in it.
: Die
: Also you haven't told me your thoughts yet.
: I'm genuinely curious.
: Did you really go out and buy a new bra just because Miku made fun of it the other day?
: THEREW EWHRE OTHER REASONS
: There* were*
: Was one of them wanting to turn me on?
: Yes.
: Oh.
: I didn't expect you to answer that honestly.
: Did it work?
: Turning you on I mean.
: I can maybe send more if it did. Idk
: I'm actually at the grocery store right now. And at least four other people saw me open that up.
: Are THEY turned on at least? Maybe one of them will come fuck me since you're clearly too busy.
: Just kidding. That made me sound easy and I like to think I'm at least a little bit of a challenge.
: Also please tell me you were joking.
: I was joking. I'm alone right now.
: Okay good. Me too.
: What are you wearing
: A robe and a wizard hat.
: Guess I'll just fuck myself then
: Literally
: Have fun, Makoto.
: Die.
: Where's that vibrator you like so much? I don't see it.
: You mean the one I only took home with me because you coerced me into defiling it in my family's store?
: Yeah.
: My dresser
: And no, I will not be sending you any more pictures involving it.
: Not even if I pay for them?
: Are you actually offering to buy custom-made pornography from me or is this just the set-up to some terrible joke
: My answer to that question depends on your answer to my question.
: No, I will not make porn for you.
: Your mother would be so disappointed in you right now. Also, the picture you just sent me is basically porn.
: NO
: It is me asking for your opinion.
: Which you still have not given me.
: Why
: Too busy wondering about how this picture would look with your favorite dildo involved.
: STOP
: CALLING
: IT
: THAT
: Do you have a different favorite that you've never told me about before?
: If I say I do will you leave me alone?
: You're the one who texted me.
: FOR
: AN
: OPINION
: jUST FUCKING TELL ME IF YOU LIKE THE BRA
: Caps lock was unintentional for that last part but it helped express my anger so I kept it.
: I like your new bra.
: Thank you.
: Now take it off and go get the vibrator.
: No. Bye.
: I think I'm in love.
: With me or the bra?
: With the brand new Venture X card from Capital One.
: What
: With the Venture X, you earn 10x points back on all hotels booked through the Capital One travel portal as well as 5x points on all flights.
: And with the Hopper app fully integrated into the travel portal, you can be sure you'll always be getting the best deal possible.
: It sounds too good to be true, right?
: No it sounds like you've been hacked. Which makes me very uncomfortable on account of the picture I just sent you.
: I also forgot to mention that the Capital One Venture X card gives you access to hundreds of airport lounges throughout the world.
: WE CAN'T EVEN FLY
: But if we could, we'd understand just how valuable Capital One's partnership with Priority Pass and Plaza Premium Lounges really is.
: WHY IS THIS HAPPENING???
: Now, I know you might be intimidated after seeing that the Capital One Venture X card comes with a $395 annual fee.
: What the fuck is going on
: But with a $300 travel credit and 10,000 Capital One miles as an anniversary gift every year, it's kind of like the card is paying you to hold it.
: Okay. I am putting my phone on silent now. Goodbye.
: Free Hertz President's Circle status...a $100 credit toward applications for Global Entry and TSA Precheck...a minimum of 2x back on every purchase...
: There are just so many reasons for you to apply.
: And if you're approved through my referral link, https://capital.one/3osA8Cl, I could earn up to 100,000 additional miles to use on anything I want.
: So please, do yourself a favor and take your future into your own hands.
: Don't just THINK big things, DO big things with Capital One.
: But, as always, be sure to do your own research before making any life-altering decisions. Even IF they're the right decisions.
: You done yet?
: I thought you were muting your phone?
: I will right after I finish filling out my application for the Capital One Venture X card.
: I'm proud of you, Makoto.
: I'm proud of you as well, Sensei.
: Even if you're kind of a sellout now.
